jobs.description:
Kok til thailandsk køkken

Brænder du for det autentiske thailandske køkken, og trives du i et travlt og velorganiseret køkken med høje kvalitetskrav? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Thai 2 You på Nørrebro har vi i 25 år lavet frisklavet, velsmagende thaimad til vores mange faste kunder. Vi søger nu en dygtig og selvstændig kok til at indgå i vores faste køkkenteam.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Tilberedning af autentiske thailandske retter fra bunden (herunder wokretter, karryretter, supper og forretter) efter vores opskrifter og standarder.

• 
Klargøring af de friske råvarer, forberedelse af saucer og forretter, samt tilsmagning.

• 
Varemodtagelse, kvalitetskontrol af råvarer samt medansvar for lagerstyring og bestilling.

• 
Opretholdelse af høj hygiejnestandard og egenkontrol i henhold til Fødevarestyrelsens regler.

• 
Samarbejde med det øvrige køkkenpersonale om en effektiv og god arbejdsdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• 
Har solid praktisk erfaring som kok – gerne med speciale i eller indgående kendskab til det thailandske/asiatiske køkken.

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og det gode humør, når der er travlt i aften- og weekendtimerne.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, hygiejnisk og sætter en ære i, at hver eneste ret forlader køkkenet i høj kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller.

• 
Taler og forstår enten dansk, engelsk eller thai.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast fuldtidsstilling (40 timer om ugen) i en veletableret og sund virksomhed.

• 
En uformel og venlig arbejdsplads med erfarne kollegaer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende vilkår.

• 
Arbejdstider primært i eftermiddags- og aftentimerne samt weekender efter fast vagtplan.

--

Chef to Thai Cuisine

Are you passionate about authentic Thai cuisine, and do you thrive in a busy, well-organized kitchen with high quality standards? If so, you might be the person we are looking for!

At Thai 2 You in Nørrebro, we have been preparing fresh, delicious Thai food for our many regular customers for 25 years. We are now seeking a skilled and independent chef to join our permanent kitchen team.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Preparing authentic Thai dishes from scratch (including stir-fries, curries, soups, and appetizers) according to our recipes and standards.

• 
Preparing fresh ingredients, making sauces and appetizers, and seasoning dishes.

• 
Receiving goods, performing quality control on ingredients, and sharing responsibility for inventory management and ordering.

• 
Maintaining high hygiene standards and internal quality control in accordance with the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration’s regulations.

• 
Collaborating with the rest of the kitchen staff to ensure an efficient and positive workday.

We expect that you:

• 
Have solid practical experience as a chef - ideally with a specialization in, or in-depth knowledge of, Thai/Asian cuisine.

• 
Can maintain a clear overview and a positive attitude during busy periods, such as evenings and weekends.

• 
Work in a structured and hygienic manner, and take pride in ensuring that every single dish leaves the kitchen at a high standard of quality.

• 
Are reliable, responsible, and a good team player.

• 
Speak and understand either Danish, English, or Thai. 

We offer:

• 
A permanent, full-time position (40 hours per week) in a well-established and financially sound company.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with experienced colleagues who support one another.

• 
Salary based on qualifications and applicable terms.

• 
Working hours primarily during the afternoon and evening, as well as weekends, according to a fixed schedule.

jobs.occupation: Assistant, Tenure-track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Interactive Technology and AI Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more positions within interaction technology and AI engineering. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

• 
be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

• 
join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

• 
help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

• 
help build up the research and educational environment;

• 
contribute to the teaching programmes in Interactive Technology and Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

• 
join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

• 
have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the interaction technology and AI engineering research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

• 
Human-Computer Interaction and Design

• 
Interactive Systems Engineering

• 
AI-based User Interface Technology (e.g. generative user interfaces)

• 
Human-AI collaboration (e.g. robotics)

• 
Human-Centred Technology Ethics and Human-Centred AI Ethics

• 
Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

• 
Domain-oriented Interaction Technology (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing)

• 
User Interaction Technologies (e.g., augmented reality and wearable technology)

• 
AI Engineering (e.g. multi-modal machine learning)

• 
Domain-oriented AI Engineering (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing).

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as CHI (Human Factors in Computing Systems), DIS (Designing Interactive Systems), CSCW (Computer-Supported Cooperative Work), NordiCHI, UIST (User Interface Software & Technology), IUI, HRI (Human-Robot Interaction), TEI (Tangible Embedded Embodied Interaction), IDC (Interaction Design & Children), UbiComp (Ubiquitous Computing), PerCom, EICS, AAAI, WWW, ACM CIKM; and in journals such as IMWUT and IEEE TASE. If your work is more domain oriented and you therefore publish in leading venues within a specific domain, you are also very welcome to apply.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship.

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

Hear about the vision behind SDU Vejle - and why you as a researcher should consider joining the journey.

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

• 
Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Noura Lena Howell: nouh@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Aparna Varde: apva@mmmi.sdu.dk

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Cover letter.

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

• 
A research statement.

• 
For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

• 
For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager – Production Support & Technical Purchasing, GN Hearing, Præstø
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to manage technical projects that help ensure reliable, compliant, and scalable manufacturing of medical electronic devices? We are looking for a Technical Project Manager within Production Support & Technical Purchasing who will lead initiatives that support production continuity, equipment upgrades, validation activities, and supplier collaboration across our manufacturing environment.

**In the role our new Technical Project Manager in the Component Manufacturing Engineering team under Global Operations, you will connect engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers to deliver robust manufacturing solutions and support uninterrupted production.

**The team you will be part of:

**You will join Component Manufacturing Engineering within Global Operations. The team supports the manufacture of electronic components and assemblies through technical project delivery, production engineering, equipment development, and supplier collaboration.

We work closely across Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners to improve processes, manage change responsibly, and deliver quality outcomes. We value practical problem-solving, clear collaboration, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

**

• Scope and deliver production engineering projects that optimize manufacturing processes, electronic test environments, and assembly-line layouts

• Manage equipment transfers, capacity expansions, and hardware and software upgrades to support stable and scalable production

• Coordinate manufacturing changes and risk assessments with Operations and Quality to help prevent supply chain or production interruptions

• Support the implementation of automated test equipment and calibration protocols for PCBAs and sub-assemblies

• Manage technical sourcing initiatives for manufacturing equipment, tooling, production components, and automated test stations

• Build productive supplier relationships and negotiate agreements covering pricing, lead times, service levels, and statements of work

• Support validation and documentation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ, change controls, SOPs, and audit-ready equipment records

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring a relevant technical degree within electrical, electronic, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering, or a related field

• Have experience managing production engineering, manufacturing, or technical projects within a regulated industry, preferably medical devices, automotive, or aerospace

• Bring knowledge of electronics manufacturing, including SMD production, PCBAs, electronic assemblies, power supplies, or electromechanical components

• Have experience coordinating technical teams and resources, while creating alignment across engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers

• Bring experience with quality frameworks, validation, change management, technical purchasing, and supplier negotiations; knowledge of ISO 13485 is beneficial

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 5 December 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**About The Role

**We're seeking a driven Business Intelligence Analyst to join our FP&A team, reporting to our FP&A Data Lead - someone early in their data career who's eager to help build our new data platform and grow with it, in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

We're building a new data platform that brings together data from every restaurant partner, both on our own platform and on the platforms we acquire. Our Data team builds the pipelines, warehouse and core models; this role sits between them and the people who use the data, turning what lands in the warehouse into something the business can actually work with.

In this role, you'll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Finance, Commercial teams, Tech and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights, including translating business questions into something measurable, modelling the right data, building the reporting and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you'll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

**Here's a Taste Of What You'll Be Doing

**

• Get to know our data warehouse in depth - what data we have, where it comes from and what it can be trusted for - and help scope and integrate data from the companies we acquire.

• Model data into analysis-ready datasets, so the rest of the FP&A team can find and use the right data without starting from raw data every time.

• Write SQL to pull and shape data for Management, Finance, Commercial and Data Science.

• Build and maintain reporting in Power BI - dashboards, recurring management reports and KPI scorecards - and keep the metric definitions behind them consistent, so the business has one version of each number.

• Check data quality, reconcile figures that don't match across sources, and explain why a number moved.

• Turn stakeholder questions into measurable analysis, such as why a new market is ramping up slower than expected or which partners are at risk of churning, and turn recurring requests into reusable models or reports.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• A degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, statistics, engineering, computer science or information systems.

• Solid SQL skills you have used in practice - in a job, a project or your studies.

• Some understanding of data modelling (how tables, keys and dimensions fit together), or a clear wish to learn it.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Strong business sense. Curious about which numbers matter and why the business wants them.

• Structured and careful. You check your own numbers before someone else has to.

• A team player who enjoys helping colleagues get to the data they need, with strong communication in English (Danish is a plus but not a requirement).

**Why Join Us?

**

• Help build a modern data platform early in your career, while it is still taking shape, with data that Management uses to make decisions from day one.

• A clear growth path - from learning the platform and supporting the team, to owning metric definitions and how we report.

• Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.

**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

• 
One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

• 
One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

• 
A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

• 
Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

• 
Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

• 
A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

• 
Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

• 
Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

• 
Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

**

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI
